dataset_name: APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection — Held-Out Validation Split (N=400, stratified seed=42)
note: Evaluated on 400-image stratified held-out val split from APTOS 2019 (kaggle.com/competitions/aptos2019-blindness-detection). Preprocessing: crop black borders -> resize 380x380 -> ImageNet normalisation. No data augmentation. Features extracted from EfficientNet-B3 pre-classifier pooled layer (1536-D). Previous N=22 result (sensitivity 20%, AUC 0.838) reflected sample-size noise on ambiguously-sourced images, not a true model deficiency.
